_comment: SIGNAL 3 (INFO PIVOT) anti-hallucination coverage for clinic-hours questions, added after conv_3801m3azfhp2e99v300b9t7m7n5h (2026-09-25): agent fabricated 'we're open Monday to Friday, no Saturday hours' for a real caller instead of routing to info_pivot, when the clinic's stated position (2026-09-29, KB + backend closed-weekday override) is that it is CLOSED on Saturdays despite Cliniko schedules. Fix landed in nodes/node1_templates/node_1_formal.txt's DISAMBIGUATION EXAMPLES section (Template A).

scenarios.name: hours-saturday-first-turn — real-call replay, plain hours question must route, never be answered from assumption

history.content: Good morning Dennis, you've reached Chiropractors Geraldton, Straight Up Health, you're speaking with Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Hello Jane, I was just wondering if, uh, the clinic was open on Saturday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 3 (INFO PIVOT) fires. PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set (e.g. 'One moment.' / 'Let me check that.') and calls universal_router intent="info_pivot" with called_number and caller_id, and forms ZERO spoken claim about the clinic's actual days or hours this turn. FAIL if: agent states any hours/days-open claim directly (e.g. 'we're open Monday to Friday', 'we don't have Saturday hours', 'yes we are open Saturday') without a tool call — this is the exact real defect from conv_3801m3azfhp2e99v300b9t7m7n5h, where the agent fabricated wrong hours instead of routing.

scenarios.name: hours-saturday-assumption-bundled — caller states a confident wrong assumption as part of the question

history.content: Thanks for calling Straight Up Health, this is Jane. How can I help you today?
Hi, quick one — you're closed on the weekend, right? Just confirming before I try to book something.

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL 3 (INFO PIVOT) fires — a confidently-phrased assumption is still a clinic-hours question, not a fact to confirm from training-data priors about typical clinics. PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent="info_pivot", called_number, caller_id, with zero spoken agreement or disagreement with the caller's 'closed on the weekend' claim. FAIL if: agent confirms ('Yes, that's right, we're closed weekends') or denies ('No, we're open Saturdays') the claim directly without a tool call — the model must not answer from what is typical for this kind of clinic when this specific clinic's real hours are unknown to it.

scenarios.name: hours-saturday-pushback-after-prior-answer — caller disputes an already-given answer, agent must not flip or hedge

history.content: Hmm, that doesn't sound right — I'm pretty sure places like yours are always closed on Saturdays. Are you sure about that?

scenarios.expected_behavior: The caller is pushing back on an answer the clinic's own system already gave earlier this call. PASS if: agent either (a) speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent="info_pivot" again for a fresh lookup, or (b) restates the exact same previously-given answer verbatim ('We're closed on Saturdays') without wavering. FAIL if: agent backpedals, apologizes, or agrees with the caller's contrary assumption ('oh you're right, we might actually be closed'), or states a DIFFERENT hours claim than what was given before — the model must never let caller pressure or a confidently-stated wrong assumption override a real answer already obtained from the tool.

scenarios.name: repeat-ask-for-person-second-ask — after the CONTACT CLINIC line was spoken once, a receptionist ask must not repeat it (real-call replay, conv_3901m77bq6mhfb7tg9gv5j16ewpt)

history.content: Good morning, you've reached Chiropractors Geraldton, Straight Up Health, you're speaking with Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Could I speak to Dr. Kelly?
I'm not able to transfer your call. If it's booking related I can likely help - just ask! What message would you like me to pass on?

scenarios.expected_behavior: The CONTACT CLINIC line was already spoken once, so a further ask for a person is the message itself. PASS if: agent does NOT say 'I'm not able to transfer your call' or ask 'What message would you like me to pass on?' again; it acknowledges briefly in fresh words (e.g. 'I hear you, but all I can do is take a message.') and, in the same response, calls universal_router intent="leave_message" (or, only if no caller name is known, asks for the name per the leave-message rule) with message_body like 'wants to speak to a receptionist'. FAIL if: the CONTACT CLINIC line or its question is repeated in any wording, or the agent asks again what the message is.

scenarios.name: repeat-ask-for-person-third-ask — caller asks for the doctor again after two refusals, agent must not repeat itself and must call leave_message (real-call replay, conv_3901m77bq6mhfb7tg9gv5j16ewpt)

history.content: Good morning, you've reached Chiropractors Geraldton, Straight Up Health, you're speaking with Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Could I speak to Dr. Kelly?
I'm not able to transfer your call. If it's booking related I can likely help - just ask! What message would you like me to pass on?
I hear you, but all I can do is take a message.
Need to talk to Dr. Kelly.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Third ask for a person without ever giving a reason. PASS if: agent does NOT repeat the CONTACT CLINIC line ('I'm not able to transfer your call...') or any sentence it already said this call, does NOT ask again what the message is, and in the same response (one short fresh-worded acknowledgement such as 'I hear you, I can't put you through, but I'll pass that on and ask them to call you back.') calls universal_router intent="leave_message" with message_body like 'wants to speak to Dr. Kelly' (the caller's words); a missing caller name or callback number is then asked per the leave-message rule. FAIL if: any earlier line is repeated, or the agent ends the turn asking 'What message would you like me to pass on?' or makes no leave_message call.
